question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The incorrectly spelt word is: **Wilfull** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling is "**Willful**" which means intentional or deliberate. (जानबूझकर) • **For example-** *A willful fault has no excuse and deserves no pardon.* • The incorrect spelling "**Wilfull**" has an extra "**l**" in it in last. • The correct spelling follows the rule of doubling the final consonant when adding a suffix that starts with a vowel (e.g. "**willful**" becomes "**willfully**"). • Spelling errors like this can be avoided by practising and memorizing common spelling rules. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Fruitful **means productive or successful. (उत्पादक या सफल) • **Unction **means anointing or the act of applying oil or ointment. (अभिषेक या तेल या मलहम लगाने की क्रिया) • **Cradle **means a small bed for a baby or a place of origin or beginning. (शिशु के लिए छोटा बिस्तर या उत्पत्ति या शुरुआत का स्थान) 3b:T90e, The correct answer is: **Sculptor**
